jennifer-mak.text: Priorities: putting students first, 'empowering educators' with collaboration, professional growth and the resources they need, and partnering with families through transparency.

source.title: Jennifer Mak for TUSD School Board, Trustee Area D: home page

jennifer-mak.text: Says AI should be limited in elementary school, middle schools should teach digital citizenship, and high schoolers may use AI under teacher supervision and discretion.

source.title: Jennifer Mak campaign: Should my fifth grader be using AI? (2026-09-26)

jennifer-mak.text: Says any curriculum or textbook must align with California Common Core State Standards, with adoption decided collaboratively by the district, principals, teachers and parents.

source.title: Jennifer Mak campaign: How do you choose a school's textbooks? (2026-09-30)

jennifer-mak.text: Wants TUSD to have 'a comprehensive system to support our parents' of students with special needs, equip teachers to provide accommodations, and 'intervene early.'

source.title: Jennifer Mak campaign: 'Is my child ever going to leave special education?' (2026-09-17)

ryan-rauzon.text: Top priority: find students not meeting state standards whom a healthy district average conceals.

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: The Plan

ryan-rauzon.text: Wants tax dollars kept in classrooms 'not in offices or bloated bureaucracies,' with budgets that show tradeoffs plainly; 'we want to do the opposite of LAUSD.'

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: The Plan

ryan-rauzon.text: Will advocate for competitive teacher compensation, sustainable health and retirement benefits, reasonable workloads, manageable class sizes and strong special education support.

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: The Plan

ryan-rauzon.text: Before approving any program, will ask for a defined need, baseline data, evidence, real costs, measurable outcomes and a review timeline.

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: The Plan

ryan-rauzon.text: Wants to address school heat with air conditioning: 'We can also solve this air conditioning problem! It's a doable thing.'

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: home page

ryan-rauzon.text: Endorsed by the Torrance Teachers Association.

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: People Who Vouch

ryan-rauzon.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party and the Torrance Democratic Club.

source.title: Ryan Rauzon for TUSD Board 2026: People Who Vouch
